0022600176.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-5, ninth in the East) visit the Brooklyn Nets (1-6, 15th in the East) on a four-game losing streak, while the Nets are 0-3 at home and on a one-game losing streak. Charlotte is without Grant Williams (out, hamstring), and Coby White is day-to-day with a calf injury and a game-time decision. Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (out, leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (out, shoulder sprain), and the Hornets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 110-103 win in Brooklyn on October 21, having also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
